tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Asphalt. The page behind every screen, and the gaps between pit-board slats. Screens stand off it by tone alone, with no outline.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen. Timing tower, pit board, data screens, dialogs. Dark is an LED timing screen; light is a printed timing sheet.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Slat. Alternate tower, table and event rows, header bands, the market chip's plate, the neutral track band and floating readouts.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Cap. The band across the head of each screen and the tower, under the title plate. The face of a default button.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline tone. Chart grid and axis, meter tracks, unlit segments, position boxes, the flash on a changed row and a default button's hover face. Never an outline around a screen or a rule between rows.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs and switches; the neutral meter fill. 3:1 or better on asphalt and screen.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Timing white (dark) or sheet ink (light). Primary text and figures on every ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, times, symbols, sources, sentence-case headings of small screens. 5.3:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus outline and the current tab's plate. Same as fg on purpose: navigation never borrows a flag colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, and text selection.

tokens.name: pos
tokens.usage: Gains and RUNNING. Always with a + sign and ▲. 2.6:1 lighter than neg on dark so the pair holds without hue.

tokens.name: pos-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a gain flash.

tokens.name: neg
tokens.usage: Losses, HALTED, ERROR text, Pause all. Always with − and ▼ on figures.

tokens.name: neg-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a loss or halt flash.

tokens.name: on-neg
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill (Hold to flatten, HALTED chip).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: PAUSED, WARN and stale text. A yellow flag, never a gain or loss.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a paused flash.

tokens.name: best
tokens.usage: Sector purple. The best of the session only: the day's equity high, the leading strategy's gain.

tokens.name: flag-green
tokens.usage: Track band fill: every strategy running and the market open.

tokens.name: flag-yellow
tokens.usage: Track band fill: something paused, or the data is stale.

tokens.name: flag-red
tokens.usage: Track band fill and the Hold to flatten button: a halt, or the action that ends everything.

tokens.name: on-flag
tokens.usage: Text and icon on green and yellow flags.

tokens.name: on-flag-red
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the red flag.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE mode strip fill: real money. Inverted on purpose so it can never be mistaken for a flag.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on the live strip.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: PAPER mode strip fill.

tokens.name: on-paper
tokens.usage: Text on the paper strip.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a dialog.

groups.name: Archivo
groups.note: One variable family. Condensed for timing, normal for sentences, expanded for the wordmark. Tabular figures everywhere.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The equity figure on the pit board. Once per screen.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The PITWALL wordmark in the gantry header. Expanded, against the condensed timing type.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen titles and the tower heading, like a broadcast caption, on a timing-white plate.

styles.name: timing
styles.usage: Timing tower: positions, strategy IDs, gaps. Nav tabs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sentences: event messages, dialog copy, empty states.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, screen titles, figure labels.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Table cells and figures in lists.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Times, symbols, sources, status chips, axis labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between pit-board slats; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a figure and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tower row padding; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen padding; gap between screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Screens, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the skip link.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches, status lights, the heartbeat dot.

shadow.note: Screens and plates are slabs: their sides step down and to the right, darkening away from the face, with no blur. Only dialogs get a soft lift.

tokens.name: shadow-stack
tokens.usage: Screens, slats, the trace and the sign-in board: a 6px slab side down and right. Never blurred.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Timing-white plates: screen titles and the current tab. A 4px slab side down and right.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the scrim.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px screen-colour gap, then 2px of timing white or ink.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything you tap.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table row height.

tokens.name: banner-h
tokens.usage: PAPER or LIVE mode strip.

tokens.name: track-h
tokens.usage: Track status flag band.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Gantry header: wordmark, nav, market, Stop.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar.

tokens.name: tower-w
tokens.usage: Timing tower width on desktop.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Market chip.
